QUOTE: By default it expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx.nr` no longer compiles and callers must go through the API. Renaming the field makes it a visible break in the source, not a silent one. ... the wrapping is a source-level mechanism, not a language access control.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the member name is renamed to `private_<member>` so outside code fails to compile. That is a compile-time break by renaming rather than by language access control. It doesn't say outright that the layout stays visible and sized, but "renaming the field" and "not a language access control" carry the mechanism.
